name: Prototype 4 with all bonus and extra features added
author: Xypess
description:
Rotate camera with A and D key and move with W and S key. Rocket key is F key. Smash key is SPACE key. 

Potion gives you smash ability, Flash gives you pushback ability, Spanner gives you homing rocket ability. 

Blue enemy only can affected by smash and if you touch it, pushes you back. Boss cant affected by any. 

Extra: Particle effect when rocket collide with enemy. 
Easy: Harder enemy 
Medium: Homing rockets 
Hard: Smashingly good 
Expert: Boss battle
